entities.summary: Ludmila Andreyevna Kuprianova (1914-1987) was a Soviet palynologist and Chairman of the Palynological Section of the All-Union Botanical Society (USSR). Her scientific career spanned more than 50 years, most of it associated with the Komarov Botanical Institute in Leningrad. She was among the first to recognize the importance of vouchered pollen and spore reference collections for research. Ludmila Kuprianova was a logicians & mathematicians from Saint Petersburg (1914-09-01, Saint Petersburg–1987-01-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a leading palynologist and Chairman of the Palynological Section of the All-Union Botanical Society, Ludmila Kuprianova's work on vouchered pollen and spore reference collections significantly advanced the field of paleoclimatology, informing research on climate change and environmental history.
